repo_notes.content: Legend Engine: Pure compiler, execution engine and server for the FINOS Legend platform. About 610 Maven modules in four groups: legend-engine-core (Pure language, compiler, runtime), legend-engine-xts-relationalStore (relational and SQL), other legend-engine-xts-* extensions (external formats, service execution, function activators), and server/config modules. maven.compiler.release is 8 while CI builds on JDK 17.
